name: Assetto Corsa Competizione
author: barticekk@barticekk.eu
description:
Official GT World Challenge sim racing game by Kunos Simulazioni. The Windows dedicated server runs
under Wine. Downloading it needs a Steam account that owns ACC. Configs are edited as UTF-8 in
acc-config/ and converted for the server on every start.
startup: if [ ! -f start.sh ]; then echo "start.sh is missing: the installation did not finish. Reinstall the server and check the install output for the line starting with Install failed."; exit 1; fi; bash ./start.sh

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Assetto Corsa Competizione install script (SteamCMD, Windows depot, owned account)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

if [ -z "${STEAM_USER}" ] || [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "anonymous" ]; then
    echo "The ACC dedicated server can only be downloaded by a Steam account that owns ACC."
    echo "Set Steam Username and Steam Password, then reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" ${STEAM_AUTH} \
    +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/server/accServer.exe ]; then
    echo "server/accServer.exe is missing. Check the Steam login (Steam Guard code) and reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p acc-config server/cfg

if [ ! -f acc-config/settings.json ]; then
    cat > acc-config/settings.json <<EOF
{
    "serverName": "${SERVER_NAME}",
    "adminPassword": "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}",
    "password": "${SERVER_PASSWORD}",
    "spectatorPassword": "",
    "carGroup": "GT3",
    "trackMedalsRequirement": 0,
    "safetyRatingRequirement": -1,
    "racecraftRatingRequirement": -1,
    "maxCarSlots": 30,
    "isRaceLocked": 1,
    "dumpLeaderboards": 1,
    "allowAutoDQ": 1,
    "shortFormationLap": 0,
    "formationLapType": 3,
    "randomizeTrackWhenEmpty": 0,
    "ignorePrematureDisconnects": 0,
    "configVersion": 1
}
EOF
fi

if [ ! -f acc-config/event.json ]; then
    cat > acc-config/event.json <<'EOF'
{
    "track": "monza",
    "preRaceWaitingTimeSeconds": 80,
    "sessionOverTimeSeconds": 120,
    "ambientTemp": 22,
    "cloudLevel": 0.1,
    "rain": 0.0,
    "weatherRandomness": 1,
    "sessions": [
        { "hourOfDay": 10, "dayOfWeekend": 2, "timeMultiplier": 1, "sessionType": "P", "sessionDurationMinutes": 20 },
        { "hourOfDay": 14, "dayOfWeekend": 3, "timeMultiplier": 1, "sessionType": "Q", "sessionDurationMinutes": 10 },
        { "hourOfDay": 16, "dayOfWeekend": 3, "timeMultiplier": 2, "sessionType": "R", "sessionDurationMinutes": 20 }
    ],
    "configVersion": 1
}
EOF
fi

if [ ! -f acc-config/assistRules.json ]; then
    cat > acc-config/assistRules.json <<'EOF'
{
    "stabilityControlLevelMax": 100,
    "disableAutosteer": 1,
    "disableAutoLights": 0,
    "disableAutoWiper": 0,
    "disableAutoEngineStart": 0,
    "disableAutoPitLimiter": 0,
    "disableAutoGear": 0,
    "disableAutoClutch": 0,
    "disableIdealLine": 0
}
EOF
fi

# accServer reads UTF-16 LE; configuration.json is rebuilt from the panel variables every start
cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container

to_utf16() {
    { printf '\xff\xfe'; iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-16LE "$1"; } > "$2"
}

cat > acc-config/configuration.json <<JSON
{
    "udpPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
    "tcpPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
    "maxConnections": ${MAX_CONNECTIONS},
    "lanDiscovery": 0,
    "registerToLobby": ${REGISTER_TO_LOBBY},
    "publicIP": "${PUBLIC_IP}",
    "configVersion": 1
}
JSON
if [ -z "${PUBLIC_IP}" ]; then
    sed -i '/"publicIP"/d' acc-config/configuration.json
fi

for file in acc-config/*.json; do
    to_utf16 "${file}" "server/cfg/$(basename "${file}")" || { echo "Could not convert ${file}"; exit 1; }
done

cd server
exec wine accServer.exe
EOF
chmod 755 start.sh

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "ACC server installed, edit acc-config/*.json"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account that owns Assetto Corsa Competizione. A separate account is recommended.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code
variables.description: E-mail Steam Guard code for the first install. Leave empty when approving in the Steam mobile app.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Initial value written to acc-config/settings.json on the first install.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Initial admin password (type /admin <password> in the in-game chat). First install only.

variables.name: Join Password
variables.description: Initial join password, empty for public. First install only.

variables.name: Max Connections
variables.description: Drivers plus spectators that can connect.

variables.name: Register To Lobby
variables.description: 1 lists the server in the public lobby, 0 for private (direct IP) only.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Only needed when the allocation uses a private IP behind NAT.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Check for server updates on start (uses the stored Steam login).
